zh: 先看左邊 16 個小圖，每一個是正方形四個角的一種標法；再數綠框（可分）與紅框（不可分）：綠 14 個、紅 2 個，紅的是對角同類的 XOR 與 XNOR；右側是二分的定義。〔功能：1〕
正方形四個角的 16 種標法：綠框 14 種可分，紅框 2 種（XOR 與 XNOR）不可分。
en: First see the 16 small panels on the left, each one a labeling of the four corners of a square; then count the green frames (separable) and red frames (not separable): 14 green and 2 red, the red ones being the diagonal XOR and XNOR; the right side defines the dichotomy. [Function: 1]
The 16 labelings of the four corners of a square: 14 green ones are separable, the 2 red ones (XOR and XNOR) are not.

zh: 先看左邊的 Cover 公式與一般位置的定義，下方兩個例子 N = 4 得 14、N = 3 得 8；再看右邊 l = 2、N = 1 到 8 的表：O 與 2 的 N 次方對照，N = 4 起開始少。〔功能：2〕
en: First see Cover's formula and the definition of general position on the left, with the two examples N = 4 giving 14 and N = 3 giving 8; then see the table on the right for l = 2 and N = 1 to 8: O against 2 to the N, which starts to fall short at N = 4. [Function: 2]
Cover's formula O(N, l) = 2 Σ C(N−1, i), and O for l = 2, N = 1 to 8: 2, 4, 8, 14, 22, 32, 44, 58.

zh: 先看左圖：橫軸是點數 N、縱軸是可分機率，N = 1 到 3 時為 1；再看之後曲線一路下降，在 N = 6 通過 0.5；右邊是公式 P = O/2ᴺ 與幾個點的值。〔功能：2〕
en: First see the left chart: the horizontal axis is the number of points N and the vertical axis the separability probability, equal to 1 for N = 1 to 3; then see the curve fall steadily and pass 0.5 at N = 6; the right shows the formula P = O/2ᴺ and a few values. [Function: 2]
Separability probability for l = 2 and N = 1 to 10: 1 for N ≤ 3, 0.5 at N = 6, 0.090 at N = 10.

zh: 先看左圖：每一條曲線是某個 l 的 P 對 r；再看所有曲線都通過 (2, ½)，且 l 越大曲線越陡；右邊是為什麼是一半的四步推導，與 r = 1.5、2.5 的 P。〔功能：2〕
en: First see the left chart: each curve is P against r for one l; then see that every curve passes (2, ½) and the larger l is, the steeper the curve; the right shows the four-step derivation of why one half, and P at r = 1.5 and 2.5. [Function: 2]
P against r = N/(l + 1) for l = 1, 3, 9, 19, 49, 99, all passing through (2, 1/2).

zh: 先看兩組長條：N = 4 與 N = 6，每組有「公式」與「實測」兩根；再比較兩根的高度：幾乎一樣；右邊是實驗設定與差距 0.010、0.003。〔功能：3〕
en: First see the two groups of bars, N = 4 and N = 6, each with a formula bar and a measured bar; then compare their heights: nearly the same; the right shows the setup and the gaps 0.010 and 0.003. [Function: 3]
Formula against random trials: 0.875 against 0.865 at N = 4 and 0.500 against 0.503 at N = 6.

zh: 先看升維前的長條約一半（0.494），再看升維後的長條到頂（1.000）；右邊是多加的三個二次座標與 N = 6 ≤ l + 1 = 6。〔功能：2〕
N = 6 時升維前後的可分比例：l = 2 為 0.494，l = 5 為 1.000。
en: First see the bars before lifting at about one half (0.494), then the bars after lifting at the top (1.000); the right shows the three added quadratic coordinates and N = 6 ≤ l + 1 = 6. [Function: 2]
Separable fraction at N = 6 before and after lifting: 0.494 at l = 2 and 1.000 at l = 5.

zh: 先看左圖：橫軸是維度 l、縱軸是可分機率；再看曲線在 l = 49 附近通過 0.5，之後迅速爬到接近 1；右邊是 l = 40 到 68 的值。〔功能：2〕
en: First see the left chart: the horizontal axis is the dimension l and the vertical axis the separability probability; then see the curve pass 0.5 near l = 49 and climb quickly toward 1; the right lists the values for l = 40 to 68. [Function: 2]
Separability probability against dimension l at N = 100: 0.5 at l = 49 and 0.9999 at l = 68.

zh: 先看「訓練」那根長條：全對；再看「新資料」那根：約 50%；右邊是實驗設定與結果。同一個分類器，兩個數字天差地別。〔功能：3〕
同一個分類器：訓練 100%、新資料 50.4%。
en: First see the training bar: all correct; then see the new-data bar: about 50%; the right shows the setup and the result. The same classifier, two very different numbers. [Function: 3]
The same classifier: 100% on training and 50.4% on new data.
The left is Q1: O(5, 2) = 22 and P = 0.6875; the right is Q2: raising l to 3 gives O(5, 3) = 30 and P = 0.9375, each with its check. [Function: 3]
Two exercises with worked answers: O(5, 2) = 22, P = 0.6875; O(5, 3) = 30, P = 0.9375.
